## Activity

Central Eye Clinic recorded 201 captures during May 2023. Activity was completed through the clinic’s routine image capture process. The recorded total provides the basis for reviewing the site’s workload for the month and supports comparison with operational records. Staff should continue to record capture activity promptly and ensure that any interruptions or equipment concerns are reported through the usual local arrangements.

## Image quality

A total of 2 captures were assessed as ungradable, representing an ungradable rate of 1.0. These images could not be used for grading and should be considered in the review of image capture practice. The clinic lead asks that recurring camera issues are logged with the service desk so that problems can be monitored and addressed.

## Grading

Grading identified 42 referable results. The median lag from image capture to grading was 2. This measure should continue to be monitored alongside activity and image quality, with particular attention to maintaining timely review of images requiring further action. Overall, the results provide a basis for routine operational follow-up at Central Eye Clinic.
